Asturian

[edit]

Adjective

[edit]

canadiense (epicene, plural canadienses)

  1. Canadian

Noun

[edit]

canadiense m or f (plural canadienses)

  1. Canadian

Related terms

[edit]
  • Canadá

Spanish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Canadá +‎ -ense.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /kanaˈdjense/ [ka.naˈð̞jẽn.se]
  • Audio (Spain):(file)
  • Rhymes: -ense
  • Syllabification: ca‧na‧dien‧se

Noun

[edit]

canadiense m or f by sense (plural canadienses)

  1. Canadian (native or inhabitant of Canada)
    ¿Conoces al canadiense?
    Do you know the Canadian?
    • 2019 February 17, Francisco Martínez Hoyos, “10 idiomas que se crearon de la nada”, in La Vanguardia‎[1]:
      El toki pona, diseñado por la canadiense Sonja Lang, se basa en el taoísmo y pretende ser “un yoga para la mente”.
      Toki Pona, designed by the Canadian Sonja Lang, is based on Taoism and aims to be “a yoga for the mind”.

Adjective

[edit]

canadiense m or f (masculine and feminine plural canadienses)

  1. Canadian (of, from or relating to Canada)
    No entiendo muy bien el gobierno canadiense.
    I don't understand the Canadian government very well.
